name: MonarchMyStatus
title: MyStatus
wrapsNative: Button with a private ButtonStyle around MonarchAvatar (with its presence dot) and two Text lines; TimelineView with a schedule that ends at the status's until time
summary: The signed-in person's avatar, presence and custom status, as one row that opens their status settings.
whenToUse: At the top of a sidebar, an account screen or a workspace switcher, where people check and change their own status.
whenNotToUse: Not for other people (use MonarchAvatar with a presence, or a member row). Not for the account menu itself (use the account menu).
api: init(_ name: String, url: URL?, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus, customStatus: MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus? = nil, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchMyStatusLabels = MonarchMyStatusLabels(), action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)

init(_ name: String, image: Image?, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus, customStatus: MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus? = nil, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchMyStatusLabels = MonarchMyStatusLabels(), action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)
struct MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus { init(_ text: String? = nil, emoji: String? = nil, until: Date? = nil) }
struct MonarchMyStatusLabels { init(hint: String? = nil, setStatus: String? = nil, presence: (@Sendable (MonarchPresenceStatus) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: name
options.description: The person's display name, already localised. Also the avatar's initials.

options.name: url / image
options.description: The avatar, loaded with AsyncImage from a URL or given as an Image; nil shows the initials.

options.name: presence
options.description: Online, away, busy, do not disturb or offline. Drawn as the avatar's presence dot.

options.name: customStatus
options.description: The person's own message and emoji, with an optional until time after which it is hidden.

options.name: now
options.description: The time until is compared with. Without it the row reads the current time and draws itself again when the status ends; pass it for a fixed rendering.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the hint, the "Set a status" invitation and the presence names.

options.name: action
options.description: Opens the status settings, usually a sheet the app presents.

states.name: custom status
states.description: The emoji and message under the name, in the muted text colour.

states.name: presence only
states.description: Without a status, away, busy and do not disturb are written under the name.

states.name: no status
states.description: Online or offline without a status shows "Set a status" in the subtle text colour.

states.name: expired
states.description: A status whose until has passed is hidden, at that moment, without the app doing anything.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The row gets the muted background.

appearance: A small avatar with its presence dot, the name in the strong body style and a caption line under it, on no background until pressed (the muted background role). All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web renders a link with href or a button; on iOS the row is always a button and the app navigates or presents a sheet in the action. The web re-renders with a timer when until passes; on iOS a TimelineView schedule ends at until. The web reads "Your status and settings" before the name; on iOS that is the hint. Android has the same parameters.
accessibility: The row is one button, named by the person's name.
Its value is the presence and the status line, such as "Online, On holiday", or just the presence when the line is the presence.
Its hint is "Opens your status and settings".
The presence is always in words, so it never depends on the dot's colour; the avatar is hidden as decorative.
The row is at least 44 points high and the text wraps at large sizes.
edgeCases: A status made of spaces is treated as no status.
An emoji without a message shows the emoji alone.
An until in the past hides the status at once.
